facts.business: Asian Star Company Limited is one of the world's leading diamantaires primarily engaged in the business of diamond cutting and polishing, and jewellery manufacturing.
key_risks: commodity price risks due to fluctuations in the prices of gold
foreign currency risk as it is involved in import and export of goods
restrained discretionary spending in key consuming markets
continued corrections in polished diamond prices
facts.related_party_note: The corporate guarantee of Rs. 8,558.14 lakhs provided in favour of Asian Star FZCO (formerly known as Asian Star DMCC - wholly owned subsidiary) was released in the financial year 2025–26.
